purpose: Public-safe onboarding contract for adding additional research projects to the static Research Command Center without project-specific renderer changes.
onboardingGates: Project identity is supported by an authoritative or controlled record.
Public classification and lifecycle status are independently supportable.
Every public matrix row resolves to an existing project and milestone.
Every non-null outputId resolves to an output owned by the same project and milestone.
Every non-null publicationId resolves to a verified project publication binding.
No private Drive URL, participant data, confidential protocol, reviewer correspondence, unpublished finding, secret, or hidden private field is committed to the public repository.
Unknown status is represented as not-publicly-confirmed rather than inferred.
Validator returns zero blocking errors before a project is exposed as public-summary.
secondProjectNote: No second project is included by this contract. A new project must pass the evidence and validation gates before being added to the public registry.
